name: Sendr
desc: Create personalized landing pages, dynamic audio, video, and manage campaigns with Sendr.

actions.name: get_user_info
actions.description: Returns information about the currently connected Sendr API user. Useful for verifying that your API key is valid.

actions.name: list_sheets
actions.description: Lists all available contact lists (sheets) in your Sendr workspace.

actions.name: get_sheet
actions.description: Returns details of a specific contact list (sheet).

actions.name: get_sheet_columns
actions.description: Returns all columns (fields) of a contact list, including their enrichment status.

actions.name: add_row_to_sheet
actions.description: Adds a new contact or record to a selected contact list (sheet).

actions.name: list_campaigns
actions.description: Lists all campaigns in your Sendr workspace, optionally filtered by status.

actions.name: get_campaign
actions.description: Returns detailed information about a specific campaign.

actions.name: list_page_templates
actions.description: Lists all available Sendr Page templates you can use to create personalized landing pages.

actions.name: get_page_template_variables
actions.description: Returns the custom variables (placeholders) defined in a selected page template � for example first_name, company, or email.

actions.name: generate_sendr_page
actions.description: Creates a personalized Sendr landing page from a template with custom variables.

actions.name: queue_dynamic_audio
actions.description: Queues a job to generate personalized audio by replacing a target word in a base audio file.

actions.name: queue_video_generation
actions.description: Queues a job to merge audio and video or generate a lipsync video.

actions.name: list_webhooks
actions.description: Lists all registered webhooks in your Sendr workspace.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description: Registers a new webhook in Sendr to receive event notifications.

actions.name: update_webhook
actions.description: Updates an existing Sendr webhook by its URL.

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.description: Deletes a registered Sendr webhook by its URL.

actions.name: reveal_webhook_secret
actions.description: Reveals the secret key for a registered webhook so you can verify incoming signatures.

actions.name: toggle_webhook
actions.description: Enables or disables a registered Sendr webhook.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: page_render_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Sendr Page is rendered.

triggers.name: page_render_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a Sendr Page render is updated (e.g. GIF or audio is ready).

triggers.name: contact_page_engagement_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a contact visits a Sendr Page for the first time.

triggers.name: contact_page_engagement_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a contact interacts with a Sendr Page again (e.g. replays, re-visits).
